llm_response.reason: Multiple independent reviews indicate xsales24.com exhibits key scam website characteristics: 1) Unusually low and unrealistic prices; 2) No legitimate contact information, only generic pages; 3) Anonymous ownership and privacy features used for site and DNS; 4) Stolen product info from other retailers; 5) Frequent consumer complaints of non-delivery, fake tracking, and evasive 'customer service' offering partial refunds to avoid chargebacks; 6) Recent domain registration and little transparency. These match the profile of a Fake Online Shopping scam website.
